svg.aria-label: Converting mean radiant heat into an annual gas volume
svg.title: Converting mean radiant heat into an annual gas volume
svg.text: gas flared (billion m³ per year) = 0.0116 × MW
Ticks: the 651 sites seen flaring on clear nights, 9 Aug–4 Nov 2026. Together they average 877 MW,
which converts to 10.2 billion m³ a year. One megawatt held all year is 11.6 million m³ of gas.
